name: clementina-sdk
description: Shared development SDK for the Clementina homebrew computer

scripts.build: npm run build -w @clementina/core && npm run build -w @clementina/assets && npm run build -w @clementina/project && npm run build -w @clementina/basic && npm run build -w @clementina/emulator-client && npm run build -w @clementina/cli && npm run build -w @clementina/mcp
scripts.test: npm run validate:specs && npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
